newsitem.title: USA: Todd-AO files for 2.5 mln Class A shares.
newsitem.headline: Todd-AO files for 2.5 mln Class A shares.

text.p: Todd-AO Corp said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2.5 million Class A common shares.
The underwriters have been offered an over-allotment option of up to 375,000 additional Class A common shares. The offering will be made through Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and Brean Murray & Co Inc.
After the offering there will be 9,055,640 Class A common shares and 1,747,181 Class B common shares outstanding.
The company said net proceeds will be used future acquisition, temporary repayment of amounts under credit facility, working capital requirements and general corporate purposes.
